history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity TOPS XML details.
features: This feature generates the TOPS XML Interface, specifically utilized by locations in the UK.
PR should have been generated for the Booking and Position date should be available for the same

events.description: Generates the TOPS XML Interface for the selected PR/containers that have a container position date.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the Menu icon near Depot Activity and clicks TOPS XML.
